packages.label: Electron 43 minors
packages.decision: Electron 43.x is the accepted desktop Chromium line; desktop smoke remains a release gate.

packages.label: Vite 8 minors
packages.decision: Vite 8.x is accepted while the initial-shell and lazy-boundary budgets stay enforced.

packages.label: React 19.2
packages.decision: React and React DOM stay on the matched 19.2 line until the shell and hook suite passes together.

packages.label: Transformers.js 4.x
packages.decision: Transformers.js 4.2.x is the accepted runtime line; 4.3+ remains an explicit deferred hold below.

packages.label: ONNX Runtime
packages.decision: The direct native/web runtimes are pinned to 1.27.x; older nested Transformers.js runtime copies are reported and must remain within 1.x.

packages.label: PDF.js 6.2
packages.decision: PDF.js stays on the fixed 6.2 line with the malicious-document and runtime security gates.

packages.label: Playwright 1.61
packages.decision: Playwright 1.61.x is accepted for the Chromium/Firefox smoke contract.

packages.label: Current type packages
packages.decision: Type declarations are reviewed with the strict renderer and Electron typecheck rather than upgraded independently.

packages.label: TypeScript 6
packages.decision: TypeScript 6.0.x remains the tested compiler while the TypeScript 7 hold is explicit.

holds.reason: Do not adopt TypeScript 7 until its programmatic API and declarations are proven with Vite, oxlint, Vitest, React, and Electron by the full compatibility matrix.
holds.requiredEvidence: An isolated candidate install must pass npm test, npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm run build, npm run smoke, npm run license:runtime, npm run sbom:check, and npm run capabilities:check.

holds.reason: The current 4.2.0 override remains in place until the registry API, Kokoro, Supertonic, KittenTTS, and Chatterbox suite passes under the candidate runtime.
holds.requiredEvidence: The candidate must dedupe its runtime graph and pass src/lib/transformers-v4.test.ts, src/lib/kokoro-assets.test.ts, src/lib/supertonic.test.ts, src/lib/kitten.test.ts, plus the full compatibility matrix.
